description.value:
You briefly conjure a kaiju, a massive, rampaging monster with a unique name and legendary reputation. It rises from its secluded lair to annihilate your foes. The summoned kaiju occupies the space of a Gargantuan creature. When you Cast this Spell, choose one of the kaiju below to summon.

  • Agmazar, the Star Titan Speed 100 feet, climb 50 feet; Arrive (void) Channel Void Each foe in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:100] takes @Damage[16d8[void]|options:area-damage] damage (basic Fortitude save); Depart Gravitic Repulsion Each foe in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:50] is pushed 100 feet away unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save.

  • Agyra, the Forever Storm Speed 80 feet, fly 200 feet; Arrive (electricity) Breath of a Thousand Storms Agyra shoots two 1,200-foot lines of electricity, one from each of her heads. The lines can't overlap. Each creature along one of the lines takes @Damage[6d12[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Reflex save. On a failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} for 1 round (for 1 minute on a critical failure); Depart (sonic) Thunderous Blast Each creature within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:100] takes @Damage[6d10[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Reflex save and is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone] on a failed save.

  • Bezravnis, the Inferno Below Speed 100 feet, burrow 100 feet; Arrive (earth) Burrow from the Earth's Heart Bezravnis explodes from the ground where it was summoned, causing all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:50] to take @Damage[8d12[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Reflex save. This potentially collapses structures with the collapse effect of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Earthquake] spell, except there's no chance of falling into a fissure; Depart Web Hurricane Bezravnis departs with a hurricane of webbing. All creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:50] must succeed at a Reflex save or take a –20-foot circumstance penalty to their Speeds until they Escape (or are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Immobilized] until they Escape on a critical failure). The Escape DC is your spell DC.

  • Ebeshra, the Winged Razor Speed 75 feet, fly 100 feet; Arrive (teleportation) Planar Draw Each foe in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:100] is pulled 50 feet toward the center, unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save. Creatures that fail and reach the center take @Damage[10d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage; Depart (electricity) Storm Discharge All creatures in a @Template[type:line|distance:240] takes @Damage[12d8[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Reflex save.

  • Mogaru, the Final King Speed 100 feet, swim 100 feet; Arrive (auditory, mental) Trance of the King's Melody Mogaru manifests with a burst of the song that summoned him, requiring all foes within 60 feet who can hear him to attempt a Will save, leaving them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 3} on a failure; Depart (fire) Volcanic Breath Mogaru unleashes his scorching breath in a @Template[type:cone|distance:120]. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[10d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Reflex save. On a failure, it also takes @Damage[4d6[persistent,fire]|options:area-damage] damage.

  • Vorgozen, the Shapeless Feeder Speed 50 feet, climb 50 feet, swim 100 feet; Arrive Pollute Magic Vorgozen's foul presence pollutes magic around her. Each enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] that's under the effects of a spell must attempt a Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 2}. Any of your enemies that Casts a Spell within 60 feet of Vorgozen must attempt a Fortitude save with the same effects unless it's already sickened; Depart (acid) Beam of Purest Vitriol Each creature in a 1200-foot line takes @Damage[10d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage and @Damage[10d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Fortitude save.

  • Yarthoon, the Moon Grub Speed 60 feet, burrow 100 feet, fly 100 feet, swim 100 feet; Arrive (cold) Algid Beam Barrage Yarthoon fires countless beams, targeting each of your enemies within 200 feet of it. The beams deal @Damage[10d6[cold]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Reflex save; Depart (cold, water) Frostbite Mist Chilling mist surges out in a @Template[type:burst|distance:100] centered on Yarthoon and remains for 1 minute. This mist has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Mist], plus any creature within the area at the end of its turn takes @Damage[5d6[cold]|options:area-damage] damage (basic Fortitude save).

duration.value: until the end of your next turn
